description: This file defines the interface MedicationDispenseService in Java for the OpenMRS project. It provides method signatures for managing MedicationDispense objects, including retrieval, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deletion operations. The interface uses annotations for authorization controls and is part of the API package.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseService
classes.description: An interface for managing MedicationDispense objects within the OpenMRS system. It extends OpenmrsService and provides methods for retrieving, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting MedicationDispense instances, with access control annotations.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense by its numeric ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense by its UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria
methods.description: Fetches a list of MedicationDispense objects matching specified criteria.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense
methods.description: Persists a MedicationDispense object to the database.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense
methods.description: Voids a MedicationDispense, marking it as no longer active, with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidMedicationDispense
methods.description: Reverses the voiding of a MedicationDispense.

methods.name: purseMedicationDispense
methods.description: Completely deletes a MedicationDispense from the database (use with caution).
